key_insight: Zero-noise extrapolation can improve QAOA landscape accuracy while slightly worsening parameter selection, so lower estimation error does not guarantee better optimization decisions.
engineering_relevance: Evaluate error mitigation with decision regret alongside mean-squared error under matched total shot budgets.
method: Simulate depth-one QAOA for MaxCut on 4–6 qubits over 120×120 parameter grids.
Compare Richardson extrapolation orders 1–3 with unmitigated estimation using paired MSE and ideal selection regret.
Use fresh paired confirmation runs and exact-moment controls to distinguish residual-bias effects from finite-shot variance.
evidence_signal: Only 4 of 540 replication conditions survived Holm correction; all four reproduced in 100 fresh paired repetitions each, with median MSE improvements of 7.65–73.09% and median normalized regret increases of 0.0031–0.0073.
watch_item: Results concern simulated exhaustive grids—not hardware or optimizer loops—and the exploratory screen had colliding per-point random seeds.
paper_title: Decision-aware validation of zero-noise extrapolation in QAOA optimization landscapes
